description: Interactive: certification prep for Databricks' exams (data-engineer-associate, data-engineer-professional, data-analyst-associate, machine-learning-associate, machine-learning-professional, genai-engineer-associate, context-engineer-associate, apache-spark-developer-associate): each domain with its weight as Databricks publishes it, the guide sections and concepts that bear on it, how much the guide covers it (said honestly, gaps included), the official exam page and guide, and practice questions from the guide's own text for one domain. Call it when the user says "help me prepare for the Data Engineer Associate" or "quiz me for the exam". Not affiliated with Databricks; no exam question is reproduced.

domain.description: One of the exam's domains (its id, from the result), for its practice questions

done.description: The plan steps the reader has done, by number or id (from an earlier result): progress lives with the reader, not the server

exam.description: The exam: data-engineer-associate, data-engineer-professional, data-analyst-associate, machine-learning-associate, machine-learning-professional, genai-engineer-associate, context-engineer-associate, apache-spark-developer-associate. Omit it for the list.

step.description: The plan step to open at (its id, as the step's call gives it)

name: exam_prep

build.description: The commit of the deploy that answered

coverage.description: How many guide sections bear on it: good, three or more; thin, one or two; none

weight.description: Percent of the exam, as Databricks publishes it

flashcards.description: The domain's flashcards, as the flashcards tool returns them (structured content only)

index_built.description: When this deploy's index was built (ISO 8601)

plan.description: The guided plan: each domain, heaviest first, read, try the model, quiz; with the reader's progress (from done) and its next step

practice.description: The domain's practice quiz, as quiz_me returns one

practices.description: Each covered domain's practice quiz, by domain id, for the plan's quiz steps

step.description: The plan step asked for, where the card opens

ttlMs.description: How long this answer may be kept before asking again, in milliseconds

title: Prepare for a Databricks certification
